status_definitions.complete: Workflow and required evidence are complete at a green exact revision.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but workflow or acceptance evidence remains open.
status_definitions.excluded: Outside the offline product boundary, with a documented reason.

capabilities.title: Exact-revision Arch package
capabilities.limits: Rust and exact-revision Arch package CI is green at published baseline 7aec70f0f2061dcc44d49bedcb4a0a7b1ae32143; the current local-profile slice requires its own exact-tip run after publication.

capabilities.title: Bounded atomic local persistence

capabilities.title: Playable Klondike

capabilities.title: Playable Spider

capabilities.title: Playable FreeCell
capabilities.limits: Solver-grade hints and platform acceptance remain open.

capabilities.title: Playable Pyramid
capabilities.limits: Standard Pyramid is playable with deterministic numbered deals, pair-to-13 and king removal, two redeals, bounded replay/history, atomic local save/recovery, and declared keyboard/accessibility semantics; solvability metadata, optional variants, real Omarchy, keyboard-only, and assistive-technology acceptance remain pending.

capabilities.title: Playable TriPeaks
capabilities.limits: Standard mode is playable with deterministic numbered deals, bounded replay/history, atomic local save/recovery, and declared keyboard/accessibility semantics; real Omarchy, keyboard-only, and assistive-technology acceptance remain pending.

capabilities.title: Local profiles, statistics, and achievements
capabilities.limits: One anonymous device-local profile exposes per-game deals played and won using idempotent numbered-deal observations, fixed-size u64 counters, bounded atomic persistence, CAS conflict handling, retry/close guards, and corrupt-source quarantine. Named profiles, achievements, streaks, import/export, sync, multi-process merge, cross-file game/profile transactions, power-loss acceptance, and broader statistics remain planned.

capabilities.title: Keyboard and assistive-technology acceptance
capabilities.limits: Declared semantics exist; real screen-reader and keyboard-only acceptance is pending.

capabilities.title: Real Omarchy and Wayland acceptance
capabilities.limits: No real-platform evidence has been recorded.

capabilities.title: Advertising services
